name: TikTok Ads
brief: TikTok Ads can help you unleash your brand’s creative side where there’s an audience for every voice. DataChannel’s TikTok Ads Connector lets you sync data from the TikTok Ads API automatically into your data warehouse. To understand how TikTok users are interacting with your brand ’s marketing clips, use this connector to track the performance of variety of advertising metrics such as impression, spend, user action, and so on
about:
Understand how TikTok users are interacting with your brand ’s marketing clips, use this connector to track the performance of variety of advertising metrics such as impression, spend, user action. Meet all your marketing needs with TikTok Ads. Manage and access advertising, creators, commerce and other marketing solutions in one place for quick collaboration and maximum flexibility.  
  
Learn more about [TikTok Ads API documentation.](https://developers.tiktok.com/)
availableData:
[Ad Group](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/tiktok/pipelines/ad-group.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed information of an ad group, which can be customized by specifying the information needed in the fields.

[Ad](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/tiktok/pipelines/ad.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve relevant information and status of custom and automated ads in an advertiser account.

[Auction Ads - Audience](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/tiktok/pipelines/auction-ads-audience.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data for 8 dimensions such as age, gender, location, and more.

[Auction Ads - Basic](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/tiktok/pipelines/auction-ads-basic.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data at an Advertiser, Campaign, Ad Group, and Ad level.

[Auction Ads - Catalog](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/tiktok/pipelines/auction-ads-catalog.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data on Dynamic Product Ads level.

[Auction Ads - Playable Material](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/tiktok/pipelines/auction-ads-playable-material.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data on playable material level.

[Campaigns](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/tiktok/pipelines/campaigns.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all the campaigns data for an advertiser account.  
  
Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/tiktok/index.html) here.
